intro.uz: Ikki hamkasb — Dilnoza va Timur — hisobot muddati boʻyicha tushunmovchilikni muhokama qiladi. Oʻqishdan oldin oʻylab koʻring: ishda yoki oʻqishda sizda ham shunday holat boʻlganmi?

paragraphs.en: Dilnoza: Timur, have you got a minute? The manager asked me this morning why the sales report wasn't ready yesterday. I thought you were working on it. Timur: Yesterday? I'm sorry, but I was sure the deadline was Friday. That's what I understood from your email last week.

Dilnoza: Really? Let me check. Here it is. I wrote that you should send the report by the end of the week, ideally before the meeting with the regional team. That meeting was on Wednesday, so I meant Wednesday. Timur: I see. But for me, the end of the week means Friday. I didn't know when the meeting was, because I wasn't invited to it.

Dilnoza: You're right, I should have written the exact date. I'm afraid I assumed everyone knew about the meeting. Timur: And I should have asked you if I wasn't sure. To be honest, I noticed the word ideally, but I didn't think it was important.

Dilnoza: Well, it's not a disaster. The manager wasn't angry, just a bit surprised. How much of the report have you finished? Timur: Most of it. I only need to add the figures from the Samarkand office. If they send them today, I can finish it by tomorrow lunchtime.

Dilnoza: That's great. I'll call Samarkand myself and ask them to hurry. And I'll explain to the manager that it was my mistake, not yours. Timur: Thanks, that's kind of you. Maybe we could agree on something for the future? When there is a deadline, let's always write the day and the date.

Dilnoza: Good idea. And if something isn't clear, we ask each other straight away, even if the question seems silly. Timur: Agreed. I'll send you the report as soon as it's ready, and next time I'll put the deadline in my calendar the moment I get the email.

grammar.example: I should have written the exact date.

title.uz: Kelasi zamon payt ergash gapi: as soon as

grammar.example: I'll send you the report as soon as it's ready

questions.statement: Timur thought the deadline was Friday.

explain.uz: «I was sure the deadline was Friday».

questions.statement: Timur has worked in the company for less than a year.

explain.uz: Timur qancha vaqtdan beri ishlashi haqida dialogda hech narsa aytilmagan.

questions.statement: Timur had been invited to the meeting with the regional team.

explain.uz: «I wasn't invited to it» — uni yigʻilishga taklif qilishmagan.

questions.statement: The manager was very angry about the late report.

explain.uz: «The manager wasn't angry, just a bit surprised».

questions.prompt: What was the main cause of the misunderstanding?
options: The email did not give an exact date.

explain.uz: Dilnoza tan oladi: «I should have written the exact date» — emailda aniq sana yoʻq edi.

questions.prompt: What does Dilnoza offer to do?
options: tell the manager that the mistake was hers

explain.uz: «I'll explain to the manager that it was my mistake, not yours».

questions.prompt: In the last paragraph, «straight away» means …

explain.uz: Tushunarsiz narsa boʻlsa, «darhol» soʻrashga kelishishadi: «we ask each other straight away».

questions.prompt: Timur still needs to add the ___ from the Samarkand office.

explain.uz: «I only need to add the figures from the Samarkand office».

questions.prompt: In future, they will always write the day and the ___ of a deadline.

explain.uz: «let's always write the day and the date».
